seo.title: Websites and web apps | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: Fast, accessible websites and web apps, designed with you, built with AI doing the first drafts and testing, reviewed by people and kept running after launch. A fixed quote, from [PRICE].

images.source: A wide, calm landscape of flat faceted paper hills at daybreak. A smooth satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan runs like a fast, clean road from the lower right foreground toward the horizon, even and unbroken, with two small faceted paper swallows flying low alongside it: a fast site that keeps running. The sky is deep Partner Navy at the top, easing to Alliance Blue and a thin band of Ribbon Cyan light at the horizon. Keep the left two thirds dark and calm (open sky and soft hills) for white text. Wide 2:1. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

sections.name: What you get
sections.job: Show what a partner gets: fast pages, accessibility, care after launch and ownership.
sections.desktop: Asymmetric head, then a bento: a large card (760) holding a framed browser product visual (a sample page for [Partner name] on a Neutral 50 well) above its text and four tags; three stacked cards on the right (Accessible to everyone, Kept running after launch, Yours to keep), bottoms aligned.
sections.mobile: Stacked head, the browser card full width, then the three points as hairline rows with 32px icons instead of cards.

content.heading: Fast for your customers, simple for your team.
content.lead: Company websites, landing pages and web apps, designed around what your customers need to do and built so your team can update the content themselves.

items.title: Fast on every screen
items.text: Pages are built light and checked on phones first, so they open quickly even on a slow connection.
items.meta: Tags: Company websites · Landing pages · Web apps · Fixing AI-built apps

items.title: Accessible to everyone
items.text: Built to the WCAG AA standard: readable contrast, full keyboard use and clear labels for screen readers.

items.title: Kept running after launch
items.text: We keep it working and improve it over time, making the changes you need as you grow.

items.title: Yours to keep
items.text: You own the code, the content and the design files, whether you stay with us or not.

content.heading: AI drafts. People decide.
content.lead: AI does the first drafts and the testing, so your project needs fewer hours. People design it with you, review every page and decide what ships.

items.title: Understand

items.title: Design

items.text: AI writes first drafts and runs the tests. Engineers review every change.

items.text: Design the site with you, around your customers · Review every page before it goes live · Decide what ships, and answer for it

sections.name: Agency rates
sections.job: Compare typical agency hourly rates for web developers (US and Australia vs the Philippines, Clutch, September 2026) and set them against our fixed quote from [PRICE].
sections.desktop: Asymmetric head; a range chart (736 wide) with two bars on a US$0 to US$150 axis, each labelled with its source key and value in mono, a note that these are marketplace ranges; a white price card (520) with 'From [PRICE]' in Data/Numeral and a Secondary button; one mono source below a hairline.
sections.mobile: Head, the two bars stacked at 358 (label, value, track), axis, note, the price card full width, source.

content.heading: What agencies charge by the hour.
content.lead: On Clutch, a marketplace of reviewed agencies, most web developers in the US and Australia charge US$100 to US$149 an hour, and most in the Philippines charge US$25 to US$49. We don’t bill by the hour: you get one fixed quote.

items.title: A fixed quote for the whole project
items.text: Project management, design, testing, documentation and launch included. Changes are quoted before we do them.

body: Typical hourly rates by country. These are marketplace ranges, not official statistics, and they describe typical agencies, not our prices.
